name: Penitent of the Broken Pact
text: Lifelink. When Penitent of the Broken Pact enters, you lose 3 life. Grace: As long as you have more life than you started with, Penitent of the Broken Pact gets +2/+2 and has sanctified.
flavor: He signed the pact in blood. He tore it up on his knees, and the long road home began with a single Confiteor.

name: Rogationtide Friar
text: When Rogationtide Friar enters, create a 1/1 Sapling token and you gain 2 life.
flavor: He walks the bounds of the parish with cross and banner, and every sapling in the hedgerow hears the Litany before the spring rain.

name: Lord of the Last Pew
text: Idle: At the end of your turn, if Lord of the Last Pew is untapped and didn't attack this turn, you gain 2 life.
flavor: He sleeps through every sermon of Lent, and the old friar prays for him through every one.

name: Boethius in the Tower
text: Unmoved. Grace: As long as you have more life than you started with, other creatures you control have unmoved. When Boethius dies, you draw two cards and you gain 3 life.
flavor: In his cell he wrote that Philosophy came to console him. Then he went out to his death a Christian, and Pavia keeps his feast.

name: Abbot's Astronomical Clock
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, you gain 2 life. Upkeep {1} (At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this relic unless you pay {1}.)
flavor: The abbot built it to ring the Hours. The brothers still rise to pray them, for a clock can count the Office but never say it.

name: Gallows Oak
text: Deathtouch (Any damage this creature deals to a creature destroys it.) Regenerate (The first time each turn this creature would be destroyed, instead tap it and remove all damage from it.)
flavor: The Pact hanged its oathbreakers from the oldest oak in the wood, and the oak learned the wrong lesson.

name: Demon at the Masked Ball
text: Haste. Dread (This creature can't be blocked except by Pact creatures and Constructs.) When Demon at the Masked Ball enters, you lose 2 life.
flavor: Every guest wore a mask, so no one remarked on his until the music stopped.

name: Apostate of the Porch
text: When Apostate of the Porch enters, you draw two cards and you lose 2 life. Composure: As long as you have four or more cards in hand, Apostate of the Porch has deathtouch.
flavor: He left the Porch for the sealed books. The Pact taught him gladly, and named the fee only afterwards.

name: Bone Mill Engine

abilities.text: Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on Bone Mill Engine.

text: Dread (This creature can't be blocked except by Pact creatures and Constructs.) Assembly (This creature gets +1/+1 for each other Construct you control.) Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on Bone Mill Engine.
flavor: The guild bought bones by the cartload and asked no questions. The Pact sold them by the cartload and answered none.

name: Satyr-King of the Vintage
text: Trample. When Satyr-King of the Vintage enters, create two 1/1 Satyr tokens with haste. Whenever Satyr-King of the Vintage attacks, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: By the end of the vintage the grapes were trampled, the wine was drunk, and the vineyard was gone.

name: Planter of Slow Oaks
text: Composure: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have four or more cards in hand, create a 1/1 Sapling token.
flavor: Asked why an old man plants oaks, he said that Nature asks him only to plant, not to sit in the shade.

name: Moss-Grown Sentry
text: Regenerate (The first time each turn this creature would be destroyed, instead tap it and remove all damage from it.) Assembly (This creature gets +1/+1 for each other Construct you control.)
flavor: Its guild was dissolved a century ago. The ivy holds its joints together now, and it guards the grove instead of the gate.

name: Epicurean on the Porch Steps
text: Idle: At the end of your turn, if Epicurean on the Porch Steps is untapped and didn't attack this turn, tax 1. (The enemy player's next non-land card costs {1} more.)
flavor: "Pleasure is the highest good," he says from his cushion. The Stoics have been refuting him since noon, and the enemy envoy is still waiting for a hearing.

name: Pyrotechnic Automaton
text: Haste. Overclock {2} (You may pay an additional {2} as you play this card.) When Pyrotechnic Automaton enters, if it was overclocked, it deals 2 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
flavor: The Revel ordered a spectacle. The guild delivered one, itemised, with a surcharge for the burns.

name: Reckoning Engine of Rhodes
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, draw a card, then foresight 2. (Look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them on the bottom and the rest on top in any order.) Upkeep {1} (At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this relic unless you pay {1}.)
flavor: The Stoics called the cosmos a perfect mechanism. The guild took them at their word and built one.
